WHAT: Comprehensive dopamine-deficiency/anhedonia research document stored at anhedonia-workup-2026-03-05.md in Ned's Productive MDs folder.
SOURCE: Multiple AI agent analyses all converging on dopaminergic deficiency profile. Not an actual clinical consultation.
KEY CONTENT: Symptom profile, modafinil response as diagnostic signal, medication table (bupropion best fit, SSRIs contraindicated), Vilnius doctor list, symptom prompt for next psychiatrist.
ADHD ASSESSMENT: Booked but ~1 month wait. Ned correctly notes this is partially theater — he can mask completely since he knows what's being tested and has 25 years of behavioral control.
CRITICAL INSIGHT: Bupropion (Elontril) can be prescribed for anhedonia/depression WITHOUT ADHD diagnosis. Faster path: anhedonia symptoms → bupropion → don't wait for ADHD assessment.
